gloss_en: The kabbalistic unification (yichud) of the Tzaddik (Yesod) with Knesset Yisrael (the Congregation of Israel, Malkhut), effected when the tzaddik-giver bestows influx/blessing upon the receiver — likened in LM I:54 to the curtain (yeria) bestowing upon the Ark of the Covenant and to masa u'matan
